gen-gf-bellota-gf-petrona: Bellota's hanging s gives it away at once. Petrona, a classic serif beneath, thickens gently at its shoulders, so the stiff, single-width heading line gets a softer, more bookish partner.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-poly: Bellota's s ends drift far from its spine. Poly's bowls thin slightly at the sides, so if the heading shrinks, that uniform stroke loses ground to the body's gentle swell.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-quattrocento: Bellota draws every stroke like bent wire, bold in attitude yet never changing width. And Quattrocento, a text serif, supplies the soft variation of a lightly tilted nib, which is the pair's real charm.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-radley: Radley opens its counters so the eye slips in and out, with sturdy downstrokes and slender turns. But Bellota above it is a ribbon of constant width, so the serif's modulation stands out against it.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-roboto-serif: Roboto Serif, a text serif, spaces its letters well apart and lets its weight shift like tapered glass rods, with big open eyes. Bellota is the one for brushy, sign-painted flair.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-sahitya: Bellota loops its s ends far from the spine and keeps its curves at full thickness through every turn. Sahitya's mild modulation settles in below.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-sawarabi-mincho: Commanding in its looks, Bellota has no thick-thin pulse at all, just one stylus width everywhere. A serif like Sawarabi Mincho reads smoothly, its links lightly thinned and bowls sturdy.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-sedan: That far-hanging s in Bellota, with stems and arches of identical thickness, makes the heading unmistakable. Sedan, a serif with mellow weights and terminals held away from the stroke, gives it a bookish, authoritative companion.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-sedan-sc: Bellota keeps its thickness fixed around every curve, with an s that hangs wide. And Sedan SC, a serif with broad open counters, adds a light touch of modulation that is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-shippori-mincho: Shippori Mincho is modest, its contrast noticeable only up close. Bellota is better at pure presence, with no thick-thin change, while this text serif is better at gently weighted bowls.
